scroll-reveal-fade-blur.description: Default section-entry reveal used on .animation-item / .animation-text elements site-wide.
scroll-reveal-fade-blur.trigger: IntersectionObserver via useReveal hook, one-shot per element per page mount
scroll-reveal-fade-blur.reducedMotionFallback: content renders at final state immediately (opacity 1, no blur, no translate) with no transition

page-fade-in.description: Route-change transition wrapping the routed page content.
page-fade-in.reducedMotionFallback: no transform/opacity animation; page renders at final state immediately

hover-link-sweep.description: HoverLink primitive: a light block sweeps left-to-right on hover; sibling links inside the same .multi-hover-link dim to 50% opacity.
hover-link-sweep.reducedMotionFallback: hover state applies instantly with no sweep tween; siblings do not dim

button-press-scale.reducedMotionFallback: no scale transform; :active state expressed via color/opacity only if present

logo-grid-wipe.description: Companies/trusted-by logo grid: each logo cell cycles between two logo images via a mask wipe, staggered per-cell, looping indefinitely with a 3s repeat delay.
logo-grid-wipe.reducedMotionFallback: logo grid renders the first logo of each pair statically, no wipe/loop

scroll-scrubbed-lottie.description: Consolidate-page-only hero: a Lottie animation frame-scrubs against scroll position (Lenis-smoothed), snapping to 5 discrete progress points with a 0.6s power2.out tween between snaps.
scroll-scrubbed-lottie.reducedMotionFallback: Lottie renders its first frame statically; no scroll-linked scrubbing, no Lenis smoothing
